verdict.rationale: Codex CLI includes a dedicated 'review' command that reports prioritized findings on uncommitted changes, a commit, or a base branch (codex-docs-10), and Codex can be triggered from GitHub pull requests to start work (codex-docs-1, codex-docs-2). However, there is no evidence this review is automatically triggered on every PR (e.g., a GitHub Action/bot that comments on all PRs) — it appears to be a manually invoked command rather than an automatic gate on every pull request. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic triggering on every PR (webhook/bot integration), evidence of inline contextual PR comments, and independent confirmation of this review workflow in practice.
